description: This file declares the NetworkStatusObserver class within the TTS plugin namespace, providing functionalities to observe network connection status and handle related events.

classes.name: NetworkStatusObserver
classes.description: Singleton class that monitors network connection status and handles connection events.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkStatusObserver.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns the current network connection status.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves the security token used for network security.

methods.name: onConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles events when the connection status changes.
